items.title: Bat Sheltering Under a Leaf
items.alt: A tiny bat hangs beneath one large curled green leaf, wing tips closed around the body and two feet gripping the stem.
items.description: A tiny bat hangs beneath one large curled green leaf, wing tips closed around the body and two feet gripping the stem. Useful for habitat imagination.
